⚔️ How It Works

1
Join the action

Play during the official PH Game Night event period.

2
Make your stats count

Your performance during the event is what puts you in contention for the top spots.

3
Watch the leaderboard

The two highest-ranked players in the event stats will be recognized as the top performers.

4
Wait for the reveal

Top performers will receive a special RGD reward. The exact reward is being kept secret for now.

📅 When Is It?

Every two weeks. The official date and time for the next PH Game Night will be announced in the RGC Philippines channel.

Keep an eye on the PH channel. The next Game Night can be announced at any time.

🤖 SG Bot Channel Notice

Please take note: This is an SG Bot Channel. Event-related statistics and standings are based on the information recorded through the channel's SG Bot system. Please make sure you are in the correct channel and follow the bot's instructions when participating.

🌏 Who Can Join?

Players from the RGC community are welcome to participate. PH and non-PH players can compete in the same event.

Event recognition and rewards will follow the official PH Game Night rules announced for each edition.

🔒

THE REWARD IS A SECRET

Two names will rise to the top. What they receive? That part stays hidden until the results are revealed.

🏆 What We're Looking For

Skill matters. Consistency matters. Showing up matters. PH Game Night is designed to give active players something extra to play for while bringing more life to the PH channel.
